inputs.rationale: Fresh export metadata produced by Script 1 is required to generate release-manifest.json. Stale release-manifest fallback is forbidden.
At least one fresh Global item table is required to reproduce the public mapping.
Names and colors enrich rows but do not establish item identity.
MMO is a published runtime dataset and must be rebuilt from a fresh source.
Explicit manually maintained name/rename fields are preserved; merged runtime mappings are generated.
Machine-translated fallback names are keyed by canonical string item ID and remain isolated by dataset. They never own NUM, original, quality, or rename.
Required for Sequential stages and enemy stat reproduction.
All four Standard tables (or standard base aliases) are required. Cross-mode substitution from MMO is forbidden.
All four MMO tables are required. Cross-mode substitution from Standard is forbidden.
English localization is the authoritative mechanics source.
Russian localization enriches English results; EN remains a valid fallback.
The public review/catalog outputs require a non-empty in-game boss catalog.
Human-maintained boss cards are the index source and must be non-empty and valid.
Compact cumulative localization-key snapshot used to distinguish genuinely new bosses from the existing catalog.
Human-maintained mechanics annotations are not generated runtime fallback.
